name.fr-FR: Notions sur la vie religieuse et monastique
name.pt-BR: Noções sobre a vida religiosa e monástica

description.fr-FR: Instructions de Dom Guéranger pour la formation des novices de Solesmes, publiées en 1885 par Dom Charles Couturier : essence de la vie religieuse et monastique, excellence de la Règle, foi, espérance, amour de Dieu et de Notre Seigneur, perfection, imitation de Jésus-Christ, conseils évangéliques. Le chapitre sur l’essence de la vie religieuse n’a pas de titre propre dans l’édition ; son titre vient du début du texte.
description.en-US: Dom Guéranger’s instructions for the training of the novices of Solesmes, published in 1885 by Dom Charles Couturier: the essence of the religious and monastic life, the excellence of the Rule, faith, hope, the love of God and of our Lord, perfection, the imitation of Jesus Christ and the evangelical counsels. Authorised translation from the French, 1908.
description.pt-BR: Instruções de Dom Guéranger para a formação dos noviços de Solesmes, publicadas em 1885 por Dom Charles Couturier: essência da vida religiosa e monástica, excelência da Regra, fé, esperança, amor de Deus e de Nosso Senhor, perfeição, imitação de Jesus Cristo e conselhos evangélicos.

sources.edition: Notions sur la vie religieuse et monastique, Solesmes, Imprimerie Saint-Pierre, 1885 (domgueranger.net HTML transcription)
sources.description: Instructions to novices edited after Guéranger’s death.

sources.edition: Religious and Monastic Life Explained, authorised version from the French, St. Louis, B. Herder, 1908 (archive.org OCR text, cleaned)
sources.description: English chapters I and II correspond to the French opening chapter and chapter I; the translator’s preface is added to the Preface chapter. Page-foot notes, where any, were not separated by the OCR.
